title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Naagmati
desc: Deadly snake legends haunt a crumbling palace, claiming lives mysteriously. Officer Boominathan steps in to investigate. What dark secrets will he uncover?
